announcements.body:
Walgreens has announced and released a new scheduling app called **Workcloud Shift**, which is the official replacement for ESS41. To be honest, it's a much better experience than ESS41, and improving on ESS41 was the whole goal of Corner.

So, where does this leave corner? Right now, I'm not too sure about its future. I had a lot of ideas for it, but this new app is a pretty big improvement. (It still makes you log in every single time, though technically, Corner does too.)

If I'm being realistic, I don't have the highest hopes for Corner's future. As I've continued working on this project, I've learned more about the potential risks of Walgreens taking it down and other legal concerns.

Thank you all so much for the support. I really appreciate it. Love you all!

— Justin
